notes: City of Chicago FY2015 ACFR, Note 7 'Capital Assets' -- government-wide (Governmental + Business-type Activities) gross additions to capital assets (before depreciation), the true annual capital outlay figure. This supersedes the prior 2015 value ($2.4B), which was a 2015-2019 Capital Improvement Program 5-YEAR PLANNED allocation misapplied as a single-year figure -- a materially different, forward-looking concept than actual audited spend. All 11 years of this metric now use the same ACFR-note methodology for consistency.
